name: 3 Ingredients Coconut Milk Powder Burfi
instructions: Add sugar and allow it to come to boil till the mixture has one thread consistency
Pour coconut milk powder into this mixture and mix thoroughly and quickly
Spoon out the mixture into a greased tray
While the burfi mixture is still warm , cut it into pieces with a sharp knife
Otherwise , let it cool and then break into pieces
I prefer to do it while it is still warm
Store in an airtight container for upto a week but i am sure it won't last that long because its quite yum and will be gone in the belly soon :)
